_: Prompts de arte dos 26 chefes que ainda não têm peça em arte_v2. Mesmo formato e mesmo fluxo de assets/props/cidades-v3/prompts.json: a imagem sai da ferramenta integrada image_gen (não da API), e o arquivo gerado entra no projeto por tools/import-boss-art.ps1, que recorta, normaliza e grava as DUAS peças (256 px de combate + 64 px de ícone). Ver CHEFES.md nesta pasta.
referencia: assets/arte_v2/mob_dragao_anciao_das_cinzas.png (chefe) ou mob_arauto_das_cinzas.png (humanoide) — anexar como imagem 1, SÓ como referência de estilo
basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production pixel-art creature sprite on genuine transparent background. Reference image is STYLE and CAMERA only, never subject. Match its hand-pixelled clustered shading, hard pixel edges, saturated but grounded palette and heavy black-brown outline — a hand-pixelled sprite, not a 3D render and not a painting. Full body, three-quarter front view, facing slightly left, feet or base at the bottom of the frame, elevated game camera. Whole creature centered in a square canvas with narrow transparent margins and nothing cropped. No ground tile, no grass island, no cast shadow on the floor, no background, no scenery, no text, no UI, no health bar, no border. Readable as a silhouette at 96x96 pixels. Subject:
firstPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent creature sprite for a pixel-art RPG. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY — copy its pixel density, its clustered flat shading and its dark outline, not its subject. Create one boss creature, full body, three-quarter front view facing slightly left, standing on the bottom edge of the frame, seen from a slightly elevated game camera. Genuine transparent background, square canvas, narrow transparent margin, whole creature visible and nothing cropped. No ground tile, no scenery, no people, no text, no border, no drop shadow. Not 3D rendered, no microtexture, no volumetric light, no bloom. Readable at 96x96 game pixels. Subject:
notas: A ORDEM IMPORTA: a primeira imagem da sessão usa firstPrompt (com a referência anexada) para fixar o estilo; as seguintes usam basePrompt + o texto do chefe.
O elemento do chefe é o acento de cor, nunca a cor dominante — a silhueta tem de ler antes da cor.
Chefe do jogo ocupa mais de um slot na batalha: a peça de combate é 256 px, o dobro do prop de cidade. O importador cuida disso.
Cada chefe tem duas fases visuais no combate (BossPhaseSystem.js), e as fases são feitas por FILTRO em CSS sobre a mesma imagem — a arte não precisa de variante de fase.
Nada de tocha, poste, chão, moldura ou efeito de luz solto: qualquer pixel fora do corpo do bicho vira sujeira flutuante no mapa.
variantes: mob_primeira_voz

A Primeira Voz — a lantern-spirit of the Bosque das Vozes: a floating gathering of wisp lights that has pulled itself into the shape of a face and a pair of long thin arms, pale green-gold light held inside a loose husk of bark and hanging moss, no legs, trailing a tail of smaller lights below; nature element; level 5, so small and quiet, not monumental
mob_touro_da_colheita

O Touro da Colheita — a huge shaggy farm bull turned wild, dust-brown hide, broad splintered horns wrapped in torn harvest rope and dry wheat stalks, head lowered mid-charge, hooves thick with dried field mud; nature element; brute silhouette, no armor, no rider
mob_alcateia_branca

A Alcateia Branca — a white-furred alpha wolf of the glacier valley with frost caked along its spine and muzzle, pale blue breath, ice crusted on its paws, standing forward while two smaller wolves of the same pack are suggested close behind it as a tight overlapping silhouette; ice element; one clear dominant animal, the pack readable but secondary
mob_primeira_brasa

A Primeira Brasa — the first ember that ever burned, now a hunched robed figure made of cracked black charcoal with white-hot fissures running through it, a single steady orange coal glowing where a heart would be, ash flaking from the shoulders; fire element; level 17, ancient and heavy, embers rising, no open flames licking outward
mob_capataz_de_pedra

O Capataz de Pedra — a mine foreman golem of red sandstone and rusted iron banding, one arm ending in a worn stone pick, a broken mine lantern hooked to its chest, crimson ore veins glowing faintly in the seams of its body, standing at attention like a supervisor; earth element; blocky, industrial, no face
mob_reflexo_afogado

O Reflexo Afogado — a drowned reflection that climbed out of the lake: a humanoid of dark mirror-still water with no features but a suggestion of a face trying to copy someone, edges dripping and unravelling, pale lake-green highlights, shoulders hunched as if about to flee; water element; unsettlingly ordinary proportions
mob_porteiro_de_casca

O Porteiro de Casca — an enormous bear-shaped guardian of living bark and heartwood, moss and small ferns growing along its back, arms like two closing gate posts, eyes two knots of soft green light, seated upright and immovable rather than charging; nature element; the pose says toll gate, not hunt
mob_cortador_de_cordas

O Cortador de Cordas — a lean harpy of the canyon bridges, dull grey-green feathers, long thin arms ending in curved cutting claws with frayed rope still caught in them, a coil of severed bridge rope slung across the body, wings half-folded as if perched below a bridge; wind element; wiry, opportunistic, never noble
mob_engrenagem_mestra

A Engrenagem Mestra — the master gear of a mechanical labyrinth: a floating construct built around one enormous brass cogwheel, smaller gears orbiting it, short articulated arms of dark iron, arcane violet light glowing between the teeth of the gears, no legs; arcane element; machine first, creature second
mob_veia_negra

A Veia Negra — a cave troll almost entirely swallowed by black iron ore, jagged ore plates erupting from its back and forearms, ore dust falling from it, one still-flesh eye left in a face of raw metal, hunched and digging; earth element; the mineral is eating the body, and that must read at a glance
mob_dona_do_poco

A Dona do Poço — the woman who owns the only well in the desert: a lean desert brigand in sun-bleached wrappings and a deep hood, one hand resting on a curved knife, the other holding a dripping waterskin, seven thin shadows fanning behind her that do not match her body; water element accent on the waterskin; human scale, no monstrous features
mob_rei_sob_a_areia

O Rei Sob a Areia — the buried king still holding court: a tall crowned skeleton in rotted royal robes packed with sand, sand pouring continuously out of the sleeves and ribcage, a bent golden crown, one hand raised in command, faint arcane blue light in the eye sockets; arcane element; regal posture, not a shambling undead
mob_vigia_do_penhasco

A Vigia do Penhasco — the storm-crow lookout of the sea cliffs: a huge dark grey seabird-crow with a wingspan far too wide for its body, salt-white streaks on the wings, one eye milky, perched on an unseen ledge with wings half open and beak open mid-cry; wind element; the pose is a warning cry, not an attack
mob_jardineira_de_perola

A Jardineira de Pérola — the gardener of the pearl reefs: a massive reef crab whose shell is an overgrown coral garden, pale pink and cream coral branches and pearls growing across its carapace, one enormous claw and one small delicate claw, seaweed trailing; water element; ornate and slow, clearly a keeper rather than a predator
mob_ancora_viva

A Âncora Viva — the living anchor of the shallow abyss: a great sea serpent coiled tightly around a barnacled iron ship's anchor, body and chain grown into one another, rusted links running through its flesh, dull teal and rust palette, head rising from the coil; water element; the anchor must be as readable as the animal
mob_eco_de_seis_cores

O Eco de Seis Cores — the echo left where six elemental currents cancel out: a floating faceted crystal body, each of its six large facets a different elemental hue (red, blue, white, green, gold, violet), thin shards orbiting it, no limbs, a hollow core where a heart would be; arcane element; geometric, not organic
mob_sentinela_das_seis_correntes

A Sentinela das Seis Correntes — an arcane sentinel of pale carved stone and floating armor plates held apart by light, six thin rings of different colors turning slowly around its torso, a tall featureless helm, arms crossed in a guard stance; arcane element; balanced, symmetrical, absolutely still
mob_tecela_do_brejo

A Tecelã do Brejo — the weaver of the fungal garden: a large swamp spider whose back carapace is grown over with pale mushroom caps, legs dusted with luminous green spores, strands of web between her legs holding spore pods, poised low and waiting; poison element; patient hunter, not charging
mob_oficiante_do_oco

O Oficiante do Oco — the officiant of the hollow tree: a corrupted druid in dark bark-and-root vestments, face hidden by a carved wooden mask with too many eye holes, arms raised mid-rite holding a bundle of lit black candles, dark tendrils of shadow coming off the hem; shadow element; ceremonial stillness, never aggression
mob_ultimo_sacerdote

O Último Sacerdote — the last priest of a dead titan cult: a skeleton in heavy dust-grey stone vestments far too large for it, a titan's stone sigil hanging at the chest, one hand mid-blessing, cracks in its own bones packed with pale mortar as if self-repaired; earth element; solemn and tired, not menacing
mob_campea_invicta

A Campeã Invicta — the undefeated champion of the bone arena: a tall armored warrior in mismatched arena plate taken from previous opponents, a heavy notched greatsword resting point-down in the sand, a barred helm with no visible face, worn victory ribbons tied to the pauldrons; earth element; the stance is bored, not tensed
mob_coracao_que_bate

O Coração Que Bate — a titan's petrified heart, still beating: a monolith of grey stone roughly heart-shaped and taller than a person, deep fissures across it glowing dull ember-orange from within at the moment of a beat, stone roots anchoring it to nothing, no face and no limbs; earth element; monumental, absolutely inhuman
mob_coro_dos_lamentos

O Coro dos Lamentos — the choir of the wailing valley: a single tall spectral column made of many overlapping translucent faces and open mouths pulled into one body, tattered shroud-like edges dissolving into mist at the bottom, dim violet-white glow; shadow element; a crowd compressed into one silhouette
mob_wyvern_de_obsidiana

A Wyvern de Obsidiana — a wyvern of black volcanic glass, sharp faceted plates along the wings and spine catching cold light, deep purple membranes, two legs and no forelimbs, wings swept back mid-dive, head low and aimed forward; shadow element; angular and reflective, never scaly
mob_guardia_das_ilhas

A Guardiã das Ilhas Altas — the matriarch griffin commanding the cloud archipelago: a large griffin with storm-grey and white plumage and pale gold eagle head, a simple worn bronze collar marking rank, wings spread wide and steady as if riding an updraft, talons open; wind element; commanding and calm, not shrieking
mob_o_que_olha_de_volta

O Que Olha de Volta — the thing at the bottom of the abyss that reads whoever looks in: a vast single eye held inside a slowly turning ring of dark arcane matter, thin trailing tendrils below, the iris built of concentric arcane glyphs, deep indigo and cold gold; arcane element; level 20 and the final boss of the game — the most imposing silhouette of the whole set, and the only one that is more phenomenon than animal
